violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. List of consultants and classes provided. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

An employee was observed touching ready to eat food (cooked chicken) with bare hands. Food employees must not touch exposed, ready-to-eat food with their bare hands and shall use suitable utensils such as deli tissue, spatulas, single use gloves, or dispensing equipment. Disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
Food debris was observed in the hand-washing sink. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026

The auto dispenser at the 3-bay sink was dispensing quaternary ammonium at a concentration less than 100 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200 ppm. PIC opened container of sanitizer and manually dispensed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/22/2026
Beverage coolers were observed not maintaining ambient temperature of 41 degrees F or colder. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

Leaks were observed at the auto-dispenser for soap and sanitizer. The spray hose was observed stuck in the on position if engaged while auto dispenser was in use. New Violation. Correct By: 08/05/2026

The drain plug for the outside dumpster is missing. Drains in receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables must have drain plugs in place. New Violation. Correct By: 09/02/2024
